box.words: Under Careful and Ask every time, a task that doesn't need the internet runs its commands with the internet off.

free_sure: Free means nothing waits for you: every command and every change runs straight away, risky ones too. Are you sure?

presets.title: Ask every time
presets.words: Every command, and every change outside the task's planned files, waits for your tap.

presets.title: Careful
presets.words: Only risky commands wait for your tap (deleting outside the project, sending code, installing…).

presets.title: Free
presets.words: Nothing waits: commands and changes run straight away.

presets.title: Read only
presets.words: It can only read: no writing and no commands at all.
